This chain of targets implies a potential pathway where Hypocrellol B may influence cellular processes through CDK3/cyclin E, which could modulate the activity of the transporter. The integration of these targets highlights a possible mechanism by which Hypocrellol B indirectly affects the transporter, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The evidence supports a functional link between Hypocrellol B and the transporter, but further investigation is needed to clarify the precise molecular mechanism.
